stem:
Deborah surveyed customers in a restaurant to find out their favorite meal. The results of the survey are shown in the table.

Favorite Meals

Meal | Number of People
Hamburger and french fries | 17
Spaghetti | 8
Chili | 12
Vegetarian delight | 3

One person in the restaurant will be picked at random. Based on the given information, which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: This person's favorite meal is twice as likely to be hamburger and french fries as it is to be spaghetti.

options.label: B
options.text: This person's favorite meal is four times as likely to be chili as it is to be vegetarian delight.

options.label: C
options.text: This person's favorite meal is more likely to be chili than hamburger and french fries.

options.label: D
options.text: This person's favorite meal is equally likely to be either vegetarian delight or spaghetti.

visual_elements: Favorite Meals Table showing: Hamburger and french fries - 17, Spaghetti - 8, Chili - 12, Vegetarian delight - 3
